answer: Tie each earning agent to a pension-fund membership with years of recorded contributions. The fund signs a yes/no statement that a member number is active and has paid in for at least two years; validators verify the signature, keep only a salted hash of that number, and reject duplicates. A farmer on a shale knoll and a clerk at the zenith of a career both get one seat. A thousand fake agents would need a thousand real contribution histories, which money cannot backdate. Weakness: young or informal workers are left out.
